If you're going further, be careful.
Crell Monferaigne's forces are about. <PART>
---
They say they're just on maneuvers,
but it's clear they're preparing for war. <PART>
---
They didn't miss a beat after hearing about
Dipan. World powers love to expand.

speaker: Townsperson
original_jp: 他の国がどこで戦争しようと構わないがこの近辺でだけはやめて欲しいね
original_en:
I don't care where countries fight their
battles, so long as it isn't here.

"To the one who ends all,
the sacred gates shall open." <PART>

That's an old passage that's been passed down,
but I don't really understand it.
